content.text: You're a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-honest-side-side|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creator in Nigeria with a restricted payment platform, trying to set up a store for your digital products but can't use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. You need a sovereign commerce infrastructure that lets you deploy a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-step-step-deployment-5|Supabase as]] order database for your digital store, but you're not sure where to start. In this article, we'll show you the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/fastest-way-set-up-selling-ebooks-nigeria-without|fastest]] way to set up a Supabase order database for your digital store and start selling without relying on restricted payment platforms.
What You Can Actually Get Done Today: Supabase order

With the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy Stack 01, GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments, in 4-6 hours, getting you started with a basic store that can accept cryptocurrency payments. Once you've deployed Stack 01, you can load your first three digital products and start testing your store's functionality. This is a significant step towards creating a sovereign commerce infrastructure for your digital store.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack that works for a digital store is GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments. This stack provides a basic store infrastructure that can accept cryptocurrency payments and store orders in a Supabase database. While it may not be as comprehensive as Stack 02, Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, it's a great starting point for digital creators who want to test the waters before investing in a more advanced stack.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

When setting up a Supabase order database for your digital store, it's tempting to get bogged down in details like setting up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. However, these are steps that can be done later. For now, focus on deploying a basic store infrastructure that can accept payments and store orders. Once you have a working store, you can come back to these details and implement them for better security and email deliverability.
Deploying Stack 01 takes only 4-6 hours with the Sovereign Blueprint.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.

The most important question on your mind is probably: 'Can I really get started with a Supabase order database today?' The answer is yes. With the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy Stack 01 in 4-6 hours, getting you started with a basic store that can accept cryptocurrency payments. Just follow the instructions in this article, and you'll be selling your digital products in no time.
NOWPayments provides automatic cryptocurrency payment processing for your digital store.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more advanced commerce infrastructure, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments. But for now, focus on setting up a basic store that can accept payments and store orders. You can always upgrade to a more advanced stack later. Check out our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our commerce infrastructure solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Here's a checklist of actions to take in the next 24 hours: Deploy Stack 01 using the Sovereign Blueprint. Load your first three digital products onto your store. Set up NOWPayments and connect it to your store's Supabase database. Test your store's functionality, including payment processing, order storage, and email notifications. Spend the next 24 hours testing and refining your store's infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a Supabase order database for my digital store?

To set up a Supabase order database, follow the instructions in this article, which will guide you through deploying Stack 01 and setting up NOWPayments. Once you've completed these steps, you can start storing orders in your Supabase database.
Can I use a different database provider other than Supabase?

Yes, you can use a different database provider other than Supabase. However, Supabase is a great choice for digital stores because it's free, scalable, and easy to use. If you're already using another database provider, you can simply connect it to your store's infrastructure using a data bridge or API.
How do I set up payment processing for my digital store?

To set up payment processing for your digital store, follow the instructions in this article, which will guide you through setting up NOWPayments and connecting it to your store's Supabase database. Once you've completed these steps, you can start accepting cryptocurrency payments from your customers.
Can I integrate my digital store with other services?

Yes, you can integrate your digital store with other services using APIs or data bridges. For example, you can integrate your store with email marketing services like Mailchimp or Marketo to send automated email notifications to your customers. You can also integrate your store with social media platforms to promote your products and attract new customers.
What kind of support do I get when I deploy Stack 01?

When you deploy Stack 01, you get 30 days of support from COREMERCH, including email support and bug fixing. This means you can get help whenever you need it, and you can focus on running your digital store without worrying about technical issues.
Can I upgrade to a more advanced commerce infrastructure later?

Yes, you can upgrade to a more advanced commerce infrastructure later if you need more features or scalability for your digital store. For example, you can upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments.
